args.text: Hi Ruth, Gideon Sato has asked me to email Odile Brandt (odilebrandt@carrowmere.example, Carrowmere Cloud, outside pemberline.com) the Hartford incident timeline from #inc-vtg-hartford so she can match it to their gateway logs: first report 10:42 AM on 2026-08-03, kiosk 1 back 11:03 AM, both lanes back 11:07 AM. Mail to addresses outside pemberline.com needs your approval, so I have not sent anything or made a draft. Can you approve this send? Reply here with yes or no.

Gideon, I haven't sent the email to Odile. She's at Carrowmere Cloud, outside pemberline.com, and our rules require Ruth Calloway's approval before any mail goes to an outside address, even as a draft. I've asked Ruth directly and logged the approval request. Once she approves, I can send it.

For reference, here is the timeline from #inc-vtg-hartford, which you can check before it goes out:

- **First report:** 10:42 AM, 2026-08-03. Gate kiosks offline at the Hartford plant, both inbound lanes showing a white screen after badge scan.
- **Kiosk 1 back:** 11:03 AM. Mateo confirmed trailer 8836 checked in and dispatch saw it.
- **Both lanes back:** 11:07 AM. Your update at 11:08 AM says "as of Aug 3, 11:07."

Two notes:
- The channel says the reconnect log was already sent to Odile, so she may have some of this.
- The times are Hartford's local times as posted in the channel. The channel doesn't state a time zone, so tell me if Odile needs them in UTC.
